newsitem.title: USA: DuPont board approves 2-for-1 stock split.
newsitem.headline: DuPont board approves 2-for-1 stock split.

text.p: DuPont Co. said Monday its board of directors has approved a two-for-one common stock split, effective June 12.
"Splitting the company's stock will result in a market price that is more attractive to a broader group of investors," said Chairman Edgar S. Woolard in a statement.
One additional share of common stock will be distributed for each common share held on the record date of May 15, it said.

The split is subject to stockholder approval of a doubling of the number of authorised common shares from 900 million shares of 60 cents par value to 1.8 billion shares of 30 cents par value. Stockholders will vote on the share increase at the annual meeting on April 30, 1997.
DuPont, based in Wilmington, Del., has principal businesses in chemicals, fibers, polymers, petroleum.
Its stock rose 75 cents to $108 on the New York Stock Exchange at mid-morning.
